svg.title: P-01 Piping and instrumentation (indicative)
svg.text: Where each sensor, flow switch, valve actuator and top-up valve sits. Pipe routes, check valves and exact JVA functions to be confirmed at site survey (PLAN §14).
Level tap: pool-only suction, pool side of any check valve.
Read with P-1 off ≥ 120 s · 0–40 kPa gauge · → M3 AI8
Mains water via backflow device → SV-2 (relay 2-5)
Pump (tag P-n, driven by contactor Kn)
Pipe route / function to be confirmed
B · OUTDOOR POOL & IN-POOL SPA CIRCUIT
JVA functions and the spa-filter connection are indicative — confirm at survey (PLAN §14 Q3).
Level tap on pool-only suction, before JVA-1, pool side of any check valve.
Reads the pool even in spa mode · read with P-4 off ≥ 120 s · → M3 AI7
Mains water via backflow device → SV-1 (relay 2-4)
Swim jets & feature (own suction / return — TBC Q5)
1. Indicative only. Pipe sizes, check valves, isolation valves and the exact functions of JVA-1…3 are to be confirmed at survey (PLAN §14 Q3–Q6).
2. TE-1 / TE-3 sit at the heater inlets and give true water temperature (valid after 120 s of flow). TE-2 / TE-4 at the outlets are for ΔT diagnostics only.
3. LT-1 / LT-2 tap the pool-only suction on the pool side of any check valve, with an isolation ball valve and bleed. Readings and top-up only with that pump off ≥ 120 s.
4. FS-1…3 downstream of each filter pump prove flow. Heater enable is hardwired through the filter-pump contactor aux contacts (see E-01).
5. Top-up valves SV-1 / SV-2 keep a compliant air gap or backflow device (AS/NZS 3500). Electrical tags and relay channels match E-01 and PLAN §6.
